records.source_page: Electric Distribution Tariff Bylaw 6364 (consolidation), Rate Code 991, PDF page 11
records.notes: Provenance: live_parsed. City of Lethbridge Electric Distribution Tariff, Rate Code 991 (Standard Single Phase Distribution): 2026 rates effective 2026-01-01. records.name: General Service (Rate 63)

records.eligibility: Applies to non-residential customers and to residential premises not entitled to Rate 61, plus the “house lights” services (including common area lighting and utility rooms) of apartment buildings where the kVA Metered Demand is less than 50 kVA. Also applies to unmetered City of Red Deer services and telecommunication installations approved by the Utilities Manager where energy consumption is small and easily predicted. Consumption will be calculated based on equipment nameplate rating and operational patterns. Services are to be taken at one of the following nominal voltages: 120/240 Volts, single phase, 3 wire; 120/208Y Volts, network, 3 wire; 120/208Y Volts, three phase, 4 wire; 347/600Y Volts, three phase, 4 wire.

records.eligibility: Applies to a commercial or industrial installation where: (a) 4,160 volts or greater is available with adequate system capacity and service is taken at 4,160 volts or greater, balanced three phase and the kVA metered demand is not less than 1,000 kVA; and (b) it is reasonably forecasted that the annual consumption of electricity will be less than 250,000 kWh; and (c) The customer is not currently enrolled under any other price options or with any alternative retail electricity supplier.
records.source_page: Electric Utility Bylaw 3273/2000 Schedule D, Rate 78, PDF page 5
records.notes: Provenance: live_parsed. City of Red Deer Regulated Rate Tariff (Rate of Last Resort, Schedule D), provided by ENMAX Energy under contract with the City, for sites using less than 250,000 kWh a year (residential: up to two dwelling units). Wires charges are billed separately under the Distribution Tariff.
